so_what: In full PPR, JayJBurn's Jeanty keeps more value on three catches than two carries suggest, Washington's zero targets cap him, and haleydabb's Coleman has the ideal snaps-plus-catches profile.
RBI11 (4-4) lost Jackson and has Love and Monangai hurt, with Loveland and Williams' targets the full-PPR offset and an immediate QB need.
chrisroraback (3-5) holds both Seattle backs but lost Brissett's job to Minshew, leaving QB open.
nDabb (8-0) has Irving losing passing downs to the unrostered Gainwell, which costs more in full PPR, and every roster still has all 100 FAAB.
kickkathsass (5-3) gets Wilson's targets but has Barkley and Pollard unavailable or limited, while haleydabb (2-6) loses Bourne and can shop Coleman with no deadline.
DrGMoney (3-5) and brobertson2 (2-6) have injuries the thin 14-team wire cannot replace, so both are trade candidates.
